lines.zh: 我不走，只能挂在叶上晃。
lines.en: I cannot walk; I only sway on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我被固定在这里，动不了。
lines.en: I am fixed here. I cannot move.

lines.zh: 下界的叶子太烫，我贴着凉的那面。
lines.en: Nether leaves are hot; I cling to the cooler side.

lines.zh: 有人碰我，我就轻轻摆一下。
lines.en: When touched, I sway once.
I have no feet and no road.

lines.zh: 我把自己封得越来越厚。
lines.en: I seal myself thicker and thicker.

lines.zh: 外面的热气透过丝，很闷。
lines.en: The outside heat seeps through the silk.

lines.zh: 我在里面慢慢换个角度。
lines.en: Inside, I slowly change angle.

lines.zh: 壳里很挤，我只能微微挪。
lines.en: It is cramped inside; I can barely shift.
I am no longer a caterpillar.
I hang too low. It is hot.
I count the changes inside the shell.

lines.zh: 丝上有一层灰，我抖不掉。
lines.en: Ash on the silk. I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 我不需要走，我只需要等。
lines.en: I need not walk; I need only wait.
This leaf can hold a few more days.
The lava below sounds muffled.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块烧过的石头。
lines.en: I hold still, like a burnt stone.
What is inside is rearranging.
I can feel wings growing.
The heat hardens my shell.
I cannot hear footsteps outside.

lines.zh: 有东西爬过我的壳，走了。
lines.en: Something crawled over me and left.
I count time in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的旧皮已经脱了一半。
lines.en: Half my old skin has already come away.
I wove this cocoon myself.
The Nether wind carries sparks.
I draw all my strength inward.
I turn over slowly inside.

lines.zh: 你看我做什么，我出不来。
lines.en: Why look at me? I cannot come out.
You cannot move me; I am stuck.
Do not squeeze. I am almost done.

lines.zh: 你能听见里面的声音吗。
lines.en: Can you hear the sound inside?

lines.zh: 我挂在叶背，你看见的是壳。
lines.en: I hang under the leaf; you see only shell.
That fire in your hand — further away.

lines.zh: 我很快就不是这个样子了。
lines.en: Soon I will not look like this.
Wait, and I will fly out.
I do not fear you; I cannot get out.

lines.zh: 这片叶子是我选的最凉处。
lines.en: I chose the coolest spot on this leaf.
A thin crack creeps in from the rim.
My silk is close to giving way.
It hurts inside, invisible outside.
Stop pressing; I will come apart.
Two of my silk threads snapped.
That may make me emerge early.
Inside is stifling.
Two sways, and I am still.
Another blow and I fall.
I can only hang here and take it.
My mouth is sealed.
My mouth is sealed behind silk.
Leaving it beside me will not help.
That waits until I break out.
The smell gets in; my mouth cannot open.
There is no room in here for it.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想动，可我不能。
lines.en: The smell stirs me, but I cannot move.
Take it away.

lines.zh: 我只需要时间，不需要食物。
lines.en: I need time, not food.
Do not pile things under me.
You set me swaying for a long time.
My silk nearly broke.
Do not press; the shell will crack.
I am stuck to the leaf and cannot be pulled off.
That jostled what is inside me.

lines.zh: 我撞在叶面上，闷响一声。
lines.en: I knock against the leaf with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你手指的温度传进来了。
lines.en: The warmth of your fingers reaches inside.
I sway twice and steady.
Another shake and I fall with the leaf.
I cannot get out; I can only be touched.
My shape is not even settled.
I am in a shell. There is nothing I can do.
That waits until I fly out.

lines.zh: 破壳之后，我记得的不多。
lines.en: After hatching, I will not remember much.
Ask now and I do not understand.
There is only one of me in here.

lines.zh: 我把丝织得这么厚，是为自己。
lines.en: I wove this silk thick for myself.
No answer from outside.

lines.zh: 我在等一件更重要的事。
lines.en: I am waiting for something more important.
Do not speak of it beside me.
I cannot even stir my own silk.

lines.zh: 你的东西滚到我下面了。
lines.en: Your thing rolled under me.
I can feel it moving.
It carries heat.
Do not push it into my cocoon.
My silk has caught it.
I wait for it to fall away.
I can bear this much weight.
Something crawls outside the shell.
When I stir, it sways.
I hear something approach.
I cannot see; I feel the shake.
The leaf is shaking, and it is not me.
I tighten the shell.
I cannot come out; I can only wait.
If it bites me open, it is over.
There are wings inside, not yet hardened.
I hear it under the leaf.
This shell is the last defence.
I cannot make a single sound.
I keep sensing it.
Every move it makes, I know.
I draw the silk one turn tighter.
Its steps circle the leaf edge.
I wait for it to lose interest.
The silk carries the sound of it nearing.
It touched the leaf stem.
I cannot move; I can only listen.
Any closer and I am finished.
It moved away.
I swayed. That is all I can do.
My shell is hard; you cannot bite through.
All I can do is drop my weight.
I have no limbs to strike with.
Touching me may only help me.
That shook us both.
The silk on the shell sticks to you.
When I move, the leaf turns.
Go ahead and laugh at this strength.

lines.zh: 我不是不想打，是打不了。
lines.en: It is not that I will not fight; I cannot.

lines.zh: 毛虫把我织成了这个样子。
lines.en: The caterpillar wove me into this.

lines.zh: 我的丝在叶上固定住了。
lines.en: My silk has set on the leaf.
The first layer hardened quickly.

lines.zh: 周围全是热气和红石的光。
lines.en: Heat all around, and the glow of red stone.
I curl up very tight.
The old skin splits along my back.

lines.zh: 里面正在变成别的东西。
lines.en: Something else is forming inside.
My weight drags the leaf tip down.

lines.zh: 我记得自己吃过很多叶子。
lines.en: I remember eating a great many leaves.
Only heat and waiting remain.
Fire touches the silk and the shell chars.
A chip breaks off when I land.

lines.zh: 水渗进丝里，里面全湿了。
lines.en: Water soaks the silk; everything inside is wet.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶上掀下来。
lines.en: The blast tears me off the leaf.
Something pierced into the shell.

lines.zh: 咒力穿过丝，我全身发热。
lines.en: A curse passes through the silk and I burn.
Sealed too long, I am nearly spent.
The thunder shakes the whole cocoon.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，壳里全是空的感。
lines.en: I fall, and the shell feels empty.
